change_summary: Gate A quote completeness fails closed when source_receipt_sha256 is omitted or null instead of treating the quote as fulfilled. Malformed hashes also fail. Exact-format 64-hex hashes remain format checks only, not proof of original bytes, rights, custody, independent provider attestation, or pregame durable publication. Added synthetic regressions and a CI step. Frozen v5 and PAPER/0u policy unchanged.
assumptions: A missing original receipt hash is unknown provenance, not a fulfilled quote.
A 64-character lower-case hexadecimal digest validates shape only; no original provider bytes, chain of custody or sportsbook authorization are authenticated by this patch.
Existing synthetic samples with well-shaped receipt hashes remain paper-only and unverified.
Legacy quotes lacking a receipt hash remain in the archive and receive explicit incomplete reasons; they are never silently repaired.
The pre-start durable publication acceptance is separately scoped to issue #298.
